_doc: Arm A of the score-at-cap A/B (2026-11-02): bighero's exact from-scratch recipe (hero-1v1-scratch.json as run by bighero: lr 3e-4, fixed entropy 0.01, no frozen opponents, no_peace) with ONE change: a capped game is decided on score (cap_score_reward 1.0, truncation_reward null) instead of a loss for both seats. Hypothesis from bighero's trace arenas: with loss-at-cap the only route to +1 is elimination, so mid-game city growth was never rewarded (levels froze at turn 12, 6 builds/game vs the champion's 24) and the run plateaued at ~17-22% vs the champion tier; hero-1v1 (score at cap) learned growth. Gate at u5250: >55% vs bighero_u5250 and builds/game > 12 with city levels still rising at turn 16.
